fields.summary_ko.0: Meta Platforms (META -5.93%) went public in 2012 under the Facebook ticker (FB), but changed its name and ticker in 2021 to focus on the metaverse.
fields.summary_ko.1: Meta operates the world's largest social media platform with over 3 billion monthly active users, and recorded Q3 2026 net income of $9.86 billion, approximately 264% higher than the prior-year period.
fields.summary_ko.2: 773 ETFs hold approximately 368.8 million Meta shares, with Vanguard Communications Services ETF (VOX -3.04%) accounting for the largest 24.7% allocation.
